correctness.rationale: Complete proof of lattice membership by interval bracketing and exact bijective signed-composition count (RESULT.md Eqns (1)--(3)), then exact degree-(\(n-1\)) Newton interpolation. verify.py enumerates every 252 canonical classes, strictly checks all coefficients, independently recomputes 503 counts via coordinate DP, and matches the published (3,7) benchmark. The CSV is an exact complete finite certificate, not an infinite extrapolation.

originality.rationale: Published Li--St. Dizier (arXiv:2608.00377 §3--4) explicitly covers one of the five (\(n=14\)) exceptions and motivates the counting method; Ferroni covers single hypersimplices; Jochemko--Ravichandran covers only linear coefficients for generalized permutahedra. The new conclusions are the exhaustive strict positivity of all rank pairs for ambient \(n\le13\) and exactly five nonpositive symmetry classes at the sharp first failure \(n=14\). Actual searches and full-text implication comparisons are recorded; priority remains provisional.
residual_risks: Earlier equivalently formulated two-hypersimplex or 2/1/0-permutahedron exact tables could exist outside inspected sources and search coverage.
The counting method is closely adapted to the published specific-example proof; novelty rests only on exhaustive cutoff and five-orbit classification, not the existence of one nonpositive Schubitope.
No independent scientific or historical-priority audit performed.

value.rationale: Identifies the exact first possible dimension for nonpositivity within a natural two-summand family and completely describes the \(5/49\) first-failure configurations, including all negative degree locations. This resolves a motivated structural gap following a recent counterexample, exceeds a new numerical witness and provides a reusable exact 252-polynomial benchmark. No extension to general Schubitopes is claimed.
